item.subject: science
item.chapter_label: Earth, Sun and the apparent motion of the sky
item.stem:
The diagram shows Earth revolving around the Sun with its tilted axis. Vivaan's class asks why the Northern Hemisphere has winter in December while the Southern Hemisphere has summer then.

Which reason is correct?

options.A: Earth's tilted axis stays pointed the same way as Earth revolves, so in December the Northern Hemisphere gets less direct sunlight and shorter days.
options.B: In December the Northern Hemisphere has winter because its tilt brings it farther from the Sun.
options.C: In December the Northern Hemisphere has summer.
options.D: In December both hemispheres have winter.
